description: This file provides utility functions for tenant management in a frontend application. It includes functions to normalize tenant IDs, get/set/clear the active tenant in local storage, fetch the list of tenants for the current user, and select a tenant by making a POST request to the backend. The code is focused on client-side tenant routing and state management, with no external dependencies apart from the browser's fetch API.

methods.name: normalizeTenantId(t)
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes a tenant ID from various input formats, returning a string ID or null.

methods.name: getActiveTenant()
methods.description: Retrieves the current active tenant ID from local storage, supporting both new and legacy keys.

methods.name: setActiveTenant(tenantId)
methods.description: Sets or removes the active tenant ID in local storage. Cleans up legacy keys for consistency.

methods.name: clearActiveTenant()
methods.description: Removes the active tenant marker from local storage.

methods.name: fetchSessionTenants()
methods.description: Fetches the list of tenants associated with the current session, handling different response formats.

methods.name: selectTenant(tenantId, reason = 'user-selection')
methods.description: Selects a tenant by sending a POST request to the backend, updates local storage, and optionally logs for debugging.
